description: Resolve a company across US government sources in one call. Searches SEC EDGAR, EPA ECHO, and the sanctions lists by name and returns the candidate match and strong identifiers (SEC CIK, ticker, EPA registry id) found in each. Use this to confirm WHO an entity is and gather its IDs before pulling detail. Matches are name-based candidates to verify, not certain identity links.

name.description: Company / organization name, e.g. 'Chevron Corporation', 'Acme Trucking LLC'.

state.description: Optional 2-letter US state to disambiguate location-based sources (e.g. 'TX').

name: entity_resolve
